judge.rationale: The core implementation in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is solid and closely mirrors the reference solution, properly compiling static schemas at registration time, caching dynamic schemas in a `WeakMap`, and returning validation errors as a `ToolResponse` without leaking values. However, the candidate stopped partway through its checklist and missed all required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) as well as the migration note in `CHANGELOG.md`. Furthermore, several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema updates across calls, unknown tool throw) and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were omitted, with some tests placed in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead. It also left `.lore/dod.md` in the working tree.
